creators.name: Ant Group
creators.bio: Ant Group, the operator of Alipay, publishes open AI models under its inclusionAI organisation, including the Realtime-Venus full-duplex interaction models (2026); its embodied-AI unit is Robbyant.
creators.why: Realtime-Venus is one of the open conversational models that keep listening while they talk and delegate tasks in the background.
creators.role_zh: 中国金融科技与人工智能公司（支付宝）
creators.bio_zh: 蚂蚁集团是支付宝的运营方，通过 inclusionAI 组织发布开源 AI 模型，其中包括 2026 年的 Realtime-Venus 全双工交互模型；其具身智能业务为 Robbyant。
creators.why_zh: Realtime-Venus 是一类开源对话模型的代表：边说边听，并把任务交给后台执行。

creators.name: Cheng-Kuang Chang
creators.bio: Cheng-Kuang Chang is first author of D2 (2026), which converts turn-based spoken language models into full-duplex ones, written at MIT CSAIL with the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab.
creators.why: D2 shows how to add duplex timing to a capable existing voice model instead of training one from scratch.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院 CSAIL 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Cheng-Kuang Chang 是 D2（2026）的第一作者。该工作在麻省理工学院 CSAIL 与 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab 合作完成，把回合制口语语言模型转换为全双工模型。
creators.why_zh: D2 展示了如何给已有的强语音模型加上双工时序，而不必从头训练。

creators.name: Zhuo Ning
creators.bio: Zhuo Ning is first author of Soundwich (2026), written at Simon Fraser University with Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Daniel Cohen-Or and colleagues from Tel Aviv University and CYENS.
creators.why: Soundwich turns the single soundtrack of joint audio-video models into separate, editable stems.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙弗雷泽大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Zhuo Ning 是 Soundwich（2026）的第一作者。该工作在西蒙弗雷泽大学完成，合作者包括 Ali Mahdavi-Amiri、Daniel Cohen-Or 以及特拉维夫大学和 CYENS 的研究者。
creators.why_zh: Soundwich 把音视频联合模型的单一混音拆成可分别编辑的多条音轨。
creators.based_zh: 加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省本拿比

creators.name: Aviad Dahan
creators.bio: Aviad Dahan is first author of SepGen (2026), a multi-stem audio-video generation and separation model from Tel Aviv University with Lior Wolf, Raja Giryes and Google researchers.
creators.why: SepGen produces one audio track per sound source, which spatial audio rendering of generated scenes needs.
creators.bio_zh: Aviad Dahan 是 SepGen（2026）的第一作者。该工作来自特拉维夫大学，合作者包括 Lior Wolf、Raja Giryes 和谷歌的研究者，是一个多音轨音视频生成与分离模型。
creators.why_zh: SepGen 为每个声源输出单独的音轨，这是为生成场景渲染空间音频所需要的。

works.title: Realtime-Venus
works.description: Realtime-Venus (Ant Group with Tsinghua University, 2026-09-12) is a pair of open 9B conversational models, one for speech and one for speech plus camera video, that keep listening while they talk: they carry on through a user's 'uh-huh', stop for a real interruption, react to sounds and sights such as a microwave beep, and hand longer jobs such as a flight search to a background agent while the conversation continues. It does not produce its own backchannels while listening, so it is classed as turn-based here; weights and an Android beta app are public.
works.description_zh: Realtime-Venus（蚂蚁集团与清华大学，2026-09-12）是两个开源的 9B 对话模型，一个处理语音，一个处理语音加摄像头视频。它们边说边听：用户说“嗯嗯”时继续讲，用户真正打断时停下，能对微波炉提示音之类的声音和画面作出反应，还能把查航班这类较长的任务交给后台智能体，同时对话照常进行。它在倾听时不会主动发出回应信号，因此这里归为回合制；权重和 Android 测试版应用均已公开。
works.idea_en: Splits a voice agent into a fast conversational front end and a slower delegated back end, so a virtual interlocutor can stay responsive while it looks something up or reasons.
works.idea_zh: 把语音智能体拆成快速的对话前端和较慢的后台委托执行，让虚拟对话者在查资料或推理时仍能及时回应。
works.method: Both front ends adapt the open MiniCPM-o 4.5 (9B) to predict interaction-control tokens, response text and delegation requests on one causal timeline, post-trained on synthesised duplex, proactive and delegation scenarios; a separate Harness runs delegated tasks and returns prepared replies that the front end decides when to speak.
works.method_zh: 两个前端都基于开源的 MiniCPM-o 4.5（9B），在同一条因果时间线上预测交互控制 token、回复文本和委托请求，并用合成的双工、主动发言和任务委托场景做后训练；独立的 Harness 执行委托任务并准备好回复，由前端决定何时说出。
works.specs: 2 × 9B (Omni: audio + video; Audio) · Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5: 75% interruption response, 97% continuation under user backchannels (developer-reported)

paper.title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation

works.title: Gander (Multimodal Duplex Interaction Agent)
works.description: Gander (Tencent Hunyuan Speech Team with Zhejiang University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 2026-09-08) is an open audio-video conversational agent that keeps listening while it speaks: it continues through a user's brief acknowledgement, stops for an explicit request, speaks up when something relevant appears on screen, and runs coding or tool tasks in the background while the conversation goes on. Weights, code and training data are released; it does not produce its own backchannels while listening, so it is classed as turn-based here.
works.description_zh: Gander（腾讯混元语音团队与浙江大学、上海交通大学，2026-09-08）是一个开源的音视频对话智能体，边说边听：用户简短附和时继续讲，用户明确要求停下时暂停，画面中出现相关内容时主动提醒，还能在对话进行的同时在后台完成编程或工具任务。模型权重、代码和训练数据均已发布；它在倾听时不会主动发出回应信号，因此这里归为回合制。
works.idea_en: Like Realtime-Venus, a fast 'cerebellum' handles conversational timing while a slower 'brain' does the work, a pattern that lets a virtual human stay socially responsive during a long task.
works.idea_zh: 与 Realtime-Venus 类似，快速的“小脑”负责对话节奏，较慢的“大脑”负责干活；这种模式让虚拟人在执行长任务时仍能保持社交上的及时回应。
works.method: A streaming Thinker–Talker 'Cerebellum' built on MiniCPM-o 4.5 flattens user inputs and model outputs into one chunk-level token stream (1-second chunks, 128-chunk context) and calls a 'Brain' agent through tool calls; trained on about 2.7 million samples covering speech, audio-video, agent and interference scenarios.
works.method_zh: 基于 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的流式 Thinker–Talker“小脑”把用户输入和模型输出按块展平为一条 token 流（每块 1 秒，上下文 128 块），通过工具调用与“大脑”智能体协作；训练语料约 270 万条，涵盖语音、音视频、智能体和抗干扰场景。
works.specs: 1 s streaming chunks · 128-chunk context · ~2.7M training samples · MiniCPM-o 4.5 base

works.title: D2 (Dialogue-to-Duplex)
works.description: D2 (MIT CSAIL with the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab, 2026-10-12) converts capable turn-based spoken language models, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2, into models that listen while they speak, answer when the user finishes and yield when interrupted, while keeping most of their question-answering ability. The authors report 99.2% turn-taking success at 521 ms and 99.5% interruption success at 403 ms for Qwen3-Omni-D2; it has no backchannels, so it is classed as turn-based here.
works.description_zh: D2（麻省理工学院 CSAIL 与 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab，2026-10-12）把能力较强的回合制口语语言模型 Qwen3-Omni 和 LLaMA-Omni 2 转换为边说边听的模型：用户说完时回答，被打断时让出话轮，同时保留大部分问答能力。作者报告 Qwen3-Omni-D2 的轮次交接成功率为 99.2%（521 毫秒），打断处理成功率为 99.5%（403 毫秒）；它不发出回应信号，因此这里归为回合制。
works.idea_en: Narrows the trade-off between a capable model and a fluent conversational partner by retrofitting duplex timing onto an existing backbone rather than training a duplex model from scratch.
works.idea_zh: 通过给现有主干模型补上双工时序、而不是从头训练双工模型，缩小了“能力强”与“对话流畅”之间的取舍。
works.method: Distils a frozen offline speech encoder into a chunk-causal streaming encoder without transcripts, then fine-tunes the backbone on aligned user and assistant audio with delayed self-audio feedback and explicit control tokens for starting and stopping, at 80–160 ms chunks.
works.method_zh: 先在不需要转写的情况下，把冻结的离线语音编码器蒸馏成块内双向、块间因果的流式编码器；再用对齐的用户与助手音频、延迟的自身音频反馈，以及表示开始和停止的显式控制 token 微调主干，块长 80–160 毫秒。
works.specs: 12.5 Hz updates · 80 ms chunks · VoiceBench 70.1 · turn-taking 99.2% at 521 ms · interruption 99.5% at 403 ms (developer-reported)

paper.title: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones

works.title: Soundwich
works.description: Soundwich (Simon Fraser University with Tel Aviv University, 2026-09-30) makes an existing joint audio-video generator output separate, synchronised tracks for voices, music, effects and ambience instead of one mixed soundtrack, each with its own timing, so a sound can be retimed, muted, replaced or remixed without regenerating the picture. It needs no training and runs on frozen open models such as LTX-2.5 and MiniMax H3.
works.description_zh: Soundwich（西蒙弗雷泽大学与特拉维夫大学，2026-09-30）让现有的音视频联合生成模型输出相互同步、各自可控时间的独立音轨（人声、音乐、音效、环境声），而不是一条混音；这样就能在不重新生成画面的情况下调整某个声音的时间、静音、替换或重新混音。它无需训练，可直接运行在 LTX-2.5、MiniMax H3 等冻结的开源模型上。
works.idea_en: Separate stems turn generated sound from a fixed property of a clip into experimental variables: the same scene can be shown with and without a siren or a voice.
works.idea_zh: 独立音轨让生成的声音从片段的固定属性变成可操纵的实验变量：同一场景可以分别呈现有或没有警笛、人声的版本。
works.method: A training-free sampling scheme generates one stem per source with a shared scene representation that passes global audiovisual context between stems, and routes each stem's cross-modal attention to its own visual source.
works.method_zh: 无需训练的采样方案：为每个声源生成一条音轨，用共享的场景表示在音轨之间传递全局视听上下文，并把每条音轨的跨模态注意力引向它对应的画面声源。

paper.title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio

works.title: SepGen
works.description: SepGen (Tel Aviv University with Google, 2026-10-08) extends a pretrained audio-video generator to output, in one sampling run, the video, the mixed soundtrack and one waveform per captioned source, for example one track per speaker in a dialogue; in separation mode it splits an existing recording by text description. The separate sources can then be placed and moved in a 3D scene to render spatial audio; code, checkpoints and data are open.
works.description_zh: SepGen（特拉维夫大学与谷歌，2026-10-08）扩展了一个预训练的音视频生成模型，使其在一次采样中同时输出视频、混音音轨，以及每个带文字描述的声源各自的波形，例如对话中每位说话人一条音轨；在分离模式下，它可以按文字描述拆分已有录音。分离出的声源可以在三维场景中定位和移动，从而渲染空间音频；代码、权重和数据均已开源。
works.idea_en: Per-source audio is what spatial rendering needs: a generated scene whose voices and sounds are separable can be heard from wherever the participant stands.
works.idea_zh: 空间渲染需要按声源分开的音频：一个人声和声音可分离的生成场景，无论参与者站在哪里都能听得对。
works.method: Fine-tunes a joint audio-video generator to emit additional audio streams conditioned on per-source captions alongside the mix; a separation mode keeps the input mix clean and extracts the captioned sources from it.
works.method_zh: 微调音视频联合生成模型，使其在混音之外，按每个声源的文字描述额外输出音频流；分离模式下保持输入混音不变，从中提取被描述的声源。

paper.title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model
